2608.13210.title: NARU: A Benchmark for NARrative Evolution and Cultural Nuance Understanding in Japanese Extreme Long Video
2608.13210.paper_summary: Long-form video understanding encompasses tasks that go beyond retrieving isolated events, including tracking an evolving narrative and interpreting social meaning that may remain implicit. However, existing benchmarks rarely evaluate these capabilities jointly, particularly in high-context, non-English media. To address this gap, we introduce NARU, a benchmark designed to evaluate Narrative evolution and Reasoning on cultural Understanding in Japanese long-form video. NARU consists of 1,481 questions grounded in 155 videos totaling 146.8 hours, spanning four narrative and five cultural dimensions. To construct the benchmark at this scale, we propose a hierarchical memory-based annotation pipeline that transforms raw video into structured event, narrative, and cultural annotations, then generates questions via task-oriented synthesis and iterative shortcut removal. The construction process includes two native-speaker verification stages involving 68 annotators. Evaluations across eight model configurations reveal substantial limitations in both long-range narrative integration and culturally grounded reasoning. By exposing these persistent gaps, NARU offers a systematic testing ground for developing MLLMs capable of reliably interpreting long-form, high-context video.
2608.13210.paper_summary_zh: 長篇視頻理解涵蓋了超越檢索孤立事件的任務，包括追踪不斷發展的敘事和解釋可能仍然隱含的社會意義。<lb/>然而，現有的基準很少共同評估這些能力，特別是在高語境的非英語媒體中。<lb/>為了解決這一差距，我們介紹了NARU，一個旨在評估日本長篇視頻中的敘事演變和文化理解推理的基準。<lb/>NARU由1,481個問題組成，基於155個視頻，總計146.8小時，涵蓋四個敘事和五個文化維度。<lb/>為了在這一規模上構建基準，我們提出了一個基於層次記憶的註釋管道，將原始視頻轉換為結構化的事件、敘事和文化註釋，然後通過任務導向的合成和迭代快捷方式移除生成問題。<lb/>構建過程包括兩個母語者驗證階段，涉及68位註釋者。<lb/>在八種模型配置下的評估顯示，無論是在長距離敘事整合還是在文化基礎推理方面都存在重大限制。<lb/>通過揭示這些持續的差距，NARU為開發能夠可靠解釋長篇、高語境視頻的MLLMs提供了一個系統化的測試平台。
